articles.description: SHINCHEONJI Volunteers (SCJ Volunteers) strengthened its community service efforts by partnering with government agencies, educational institutions, and civic organizations in three initiatives supporting hunger relief, youth volunteerism, and environmental sustainability across Pasay City and Cavite. The initiatives included the Department of Social Welfare and Development's (DSWD) Walang Gutom Kitchen feeding program, Kiwanis International Philippine Luzon District's Kaalaman Champion, and the Roots for Resilience community tree-planting initiative. Twelve SCJ Volunteers supported the DSWD's Walang Gutom Kitchen in Pasay City, assisting in food preparation and distribution for nearly 300 individuals from vulnerable sectors across two meal shifts. The activity supported the government's efforts to address hunger and food insecurity among food-poor Filipino families. SCJ Volunteers also plans to deploy volunteers monthly to sustain its support. In Silang, Cavite, 21 SCJ Volunteers joined Kiwanis International Philippine Luzon District's Kaalaman Champion at Sabutan Elementary School, engaging approximately 860 students from K-Kids, Builders Club, and Key Club. As part of the program, volunteers conducted a 10-minute session introducing volunteerism and community service, assisted participants, and facilitated an interactive activity. The broader initiative aimed to reach 5,000 learners through onsite and online participation. Meanwhile, 28 SCJ Volunteers joined 122 other participants in the Roots for Resilience initiative at MMDA Nature Park in Carmona, Cavite, resulting in the planting of 500 fruit-bearing seedlings, including cashew, guyabano, and jackfruit. Through these collaborative efforts, SCJ Volunteers continues to strengthen partnerships and mobilize volunteers to address social needs, encourage youth participation, and promote environmental responsibility. For partnership opportunities and updates on upcoming activities, visit the Shincheonji Volunteers PH Facebook page at fb.com/shincheonjivolunteersph.
